scope: Dish-photo permission, exact-match controls and production fallback
decision: No image was added because no newly reviewed asset with documented reuse permission, exact dish identity and dietary evidence was available. The safe placeholder remains the launch behavior.

repository_evidence.note: Counts are field occurrences in the checked-in source-batch files, not unique restaurants or dishes.

implementation_review.upload: Only an approved owner can upload JPEG/PNG media for a dish belonging to the same verified restaurant; permission confirmation and evidence are mandatory.
implementation_review.pending_privacy: Uploads stay pending and are not publicly retrievable before review.
implementation_review.approval: Private reviewer authentication and explicit confirmation of exact dish identity, dietary identity and permission are required.
implementation_review.recommendation_display: Only approved media bound to the same dish and restaurant with an exact normalized dish-name and dietary match is returned.
implementation_review.fallback: Missing, mismatched or unavailable media returns photo=null and the customer UI keeps an explicit verified-photo-unavailable placeholder.

production_read_only_checks.result: photo=null; No verified matching dish photo available.

approved_image_inventory_note: The private reviewer queue and database were not accessed. This report does not claim that production has zero approved images; it verifies the observed recommendation fallback and access boundary.
future_asset_acceptance: Restaurant or rights-holder reuse permission is documented.
The photo is tied to the exact outlet and dish record.
Dietary identity and ingredient evidence are independently checked.
A private reviewer approves the pending asset before publication.
